name: Anacite Wingbot
source: Starfinder Murder in Metal City Deluxe Adventure

generalAbilities.name: Always Watching
generalAbilities.description: Anacite wingbots are always recording and uploading their feed through shortwave as long as they're within range of a transmitter. An anacite wingbot can project a hologram of the live footage they're recording or play back a video of anything they've recorded, which appears in the air nearby as the spell Illusory Scene.

generalAbilities.name: Shortwave
generalAbilities.description: The anacite can communicate using wireless shortwave signals. This functions as telepathy with other creatures who have shortwave and with creatures with both the construct and tech traits.

generalAbilities.name: Sunlight Dependency
generalAbilities.description: Anacites are solar powered; they're perpetually Glitching 1 while in areas of darkness and must recharge daily in direct sunlight or risk shutting down completely.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nanites
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures hit by the wingbot's sting must attempt a DC 13 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, creatures with the tech trait become Glitching 1; other creatures take 1d4 Poison Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trill
offensiveAbilities.description:
The wingbot creates a shrill trilling noise accompanied by disturbing low-level vibrations and electromagnetic pulses tuned to disrupt non-anacite creatures. Each non-anacite creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 13 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The targets then become temporarily immune to the wingbot's Trill for 24 hours.

Failure Creatures with the tech trait become Glitching 1, while non-tech creatures become Sickened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but glitching or Sickened 2.
